 Kinolune OS 0.1.0 - Installer

 Kinolune OS is installed

 Next steps:
 1. Remove the installer USB stick and reboot the computer.
 2. Admin panel: https://kinolune.local in a browser on the same network.
    If the .local address does not open, find the server IP in the router's
    device list.
 3. Sign in as admin with the password you set.

 Elapsed 31s

   Power off
   Text menu and command line
